theg pa rim dgu'i smon lam shin tu bsdus pa don gnyis chu skyes bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/spangs rtogs yon tan ldan pa'i rang gzugs ni/ /

tei:div.tei:p: theg pa rim dgu'i smon lam shin tu bsdus pa don gnyis chu skyes bzhugs so/ /

oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ spangs rtogs yon tan ldan pa'i rang gzugs ni/ / mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar gsar pa'i 'jo sgeg can/ / rgyal dang de sras des gsungs dam pa'i chos/ / gang nyid 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams kun la 'dud/ / bag yod khrims kyis rgyud bsdams so thar dang*/ / rten 'brel 'byung ldog lam khyer rang sangs rgyas/ / bdag med gzhan don la brtse byang sems te/ / kun 'byung 'dren pa'i theg pas rgyud grol shog / bdag dman lha la mchog lta bya ba'i rgyud/ / gnyis med grogs kyi tshul bzhin spyod pa dang*/ / gnyis ka ye shes lhar bskyed rnal 'byor te/ / dka' thub rig byed theg pas lam khyer shog / snod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum rtogs ma hā dang*/ dbyings ye gnyis med bde stong a nu'i lam/ / rang grol ka dag 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ / thabs kyi theg pas mthar thug lam 'grub shog / de ltar sku dang ye shes zab gsang lam/ / ma dag snang bar sbyor dang mi sbyor gyis/ / rgyu 'bras theg pa'i rnam par dbye ba kun/ / ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' rtogs par shog / 'dir ni bdag gi gzhan don smon pa'i mthu/ / mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum dkyil 'khor lhas/ / yongs su 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur mdzad nas kyang*/ / phun tshogs phan bde'i dpal gyis 'byor bar shog /ces pa'ang gzhon nu 'jigs med ye shes rdo rje'i rol pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis 'phral du gang dran brjod pa'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
